_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores, online, and through their mobile devices'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, e-commerce retail or through a combination of both areas), which could adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2014 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart

theme_watch.reason: Live: Walmart's own FY2014 10-K says 'We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, e-commerce retail or through a combination of both areas), which could adversely affect our financial performance.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'e-commerce sales positively impacted Walmart U.S. comparable store and Sam's Club comparable club sales percentages by approximately 0.3%' in fiscal 2014. The stock trades at 17.1x FY16E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Walmart's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores, online, and through their mobile devices'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, e-commerce retail or through a combination of both areas), which could adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2014 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.59x; +31% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.05; conservative 2yr -10%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -0.8%/yr (worst year FY05-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.3%/yr (FY16 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.5%/yr (FY05-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +11.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2015-03-20) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.59x (29.1% downside to Bear $59 / +8.1% upside to Bull $90) | Adj composite 1.72 vs market 3.77: gap -2.05 [OVERVALUED] | +31% above the EPP floor $63 (13x FY16E $4.88) | Conservative 2-yr case: -9.5% total (-4.7%/yr) | At 17.1x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $110 sits above the BULL case; U.S. comps +1.2% in Q4 FY15, forward sales +1-2% (FY16 net sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
